ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.DeveloperName = "Charging_Station", OR( ISBLANK(AccountId), ISBLANK(Product2Id), ISBLANK(SerialNumber), ISBLANK(Charging_Site__c), ISBLANK(Charger_ID__c), ISBLANK(Quantity), Quantity <> 1 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: For a charging station, complete Account, Product, Serial Number, Charging Site and Charger ID, and set Quantity to 1.
